## About
C Tires is a tire and car maintenance shop on Plummer St in North Hills. Drivers come to us for new tires, help with flats and alignments.
We have a 4.7 rating from 68 Google reviews. One reviewer said Alexis helped them find the right tire without any pressure or upselling, and another came in with a flat from the freeway and left with new tires and an alignment.
While you wait, there's an air-conditioned area to sit in out of the heat.

## Services
- New tires: Help choosing and installing the right tires for your car.
- Flat help: Got a flat on the road? Bring it in and we'll help you out.
- Alignment: Alignments to keep your car driving straight.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: Yes. We're open Saturday and Sunday, with shorter hours on Sunday. Check the hours listed on this page before you come in.

Q: Is there somewhere to wait while my car is worked on?
A: Yes. We have an air-conditioned waiting area, and one reviewer mentioned a vending machine there.

Q: Can you help if I get a flat?
A: Yes. One customer came to us for help with a flat they got on the freeway.
